edges.reason: ilk identifier flows into the auto-line debt ceiling update.
amount flows into the auto-line debt ceiling update.
changelog key flows into the changelog write.
address value flows into the changelog write.
base contract address flows into the authorize call.
ward address flows into the authorize call.
payment target flows into the surplus buffer payment.
payment amount flows into the surplus buffer payment.
CollateralOpts struct drives the onboarding routine.
description string stored by the constructor.
expiration timestamp stored by the constructor.
action address stored and hashed by the constructor.
cached vat address is used by the global debt ceiling increase.
local action address feeds the assembly extcodehash computation.
local tag variable is written by the assembly block.
weekday is derived from block.timestamp, a miner-influenceable value.
hour is derived from block.timestamp, a miner-influenceable value.
cast time computation is driven by block.timestamp.
eta is derived from now, which can be manipulated by miners.
spell expiration is derived from block.timestamp at deployment.
cached flipperMom is passed to the deauthorize calls.
UNIV2WBTCDAI-A struct literal is passed to addNewCollateral.
UNIV2AAVEETH-A struct literal is passed to addNewCollateral.
payment amount is scaled with multiplication by RAD.
the payment helper performs scaling arithmetic on the amount.
add implements guarded overflow arithmetic.
sub implements guarded underflow arithmetic.
mul implements guarded overflow arithmetic.
constructor reads MCD_PAUSE through the log constant.
constructor stores the pause proxy address.
constructor sets the immutable tag.
cast marks the spell as done before executing.
schedule writes eta as now plus the pause delay.
schedule uses the immutable pause contract.
cast uses the immutable pause contract.
DssSpell constructor deploys and stores the action contract.
nextCastTime branches on block.timestamp.
schedule reads now for the eta calculation and expiration check.
block.timestamp is passed from the DssSpell constructor to DssExec.
execute calls actions.
the limited modifier queries officeHours.
the limited modifier gates execution on block.timestamp based weekday/hour checks.
virtual actions is overridden by DssSpellAction.actions.
spell calls setIlkAutoLineDebtCeiling.
spell calls setIlkAutoLineParameters.
spell calls setSurplusBuffer.
spell whitelists LP oracle readers.
spell onboards new collateral types.
spell updates changelog addresses.
spell adjusts the Dai Savings Rate.
spell revokes flipperMom authorizations.
spell bumps the changelog version.
addNewCollateral calls addCollateralBase.
addNewCollateral authorizes OSM and flipper contracts.
addNewCollateral deauthorizes flipperMom for non-liquidatable collateral.
addNewCollateral whitelists median readers for OSM collaterals.
addNewCollateral increases the global debt ceiling.
addCollateralBase grants authorizations to join, flip and end contracts.
nextCastTime checks office hours on the action.
DssSpell constructor invokes the DssExec constructor.
increaseGlobalDebtCeiling uses the checked add helper.
schedule calls plot on the pause proxy.
cast delegates execution to the pause proxy which calls back into the action contract.
payment helper calls vat.suck on an external contract.
payment helper calls exit on the DAI join adapter, transferring tokens to an external target.
getChangelogAddress calls the Changelog contract.
setChangelogAddress calls setAddress on the Changelog contract.
setChangelogVersion calls setVersion on the Changelog contract.
constructor reads MCD_PAUSE from the Changelog contract.
authorize calls rely on the target MCD contract.
deauthorize calls deny on the target MCD contract.
setDSR files the dsr parameter on the Pot contract.
setIlkAutoLineDebtCeiling calls setIlk on the auto-line module.
setIlkAutoLineParameters calls setIlk on the auto-line module.
setSurplusBuffer files hump on the Vow contract.
whitelist helper calls kiss/lift on the median oracle.
increaseGlobalDebtCeiling files Line on the Vat contract.
addCollateralBase performs multiple external calls (vat/jug init, registry add, spotter/cat file).

normalization_plan.reason: ilk name parameter is only a key for the auto-line debt ceiling update and is fully absorbed by setIlkAutoLineDebtCeiling.
amount parameter is consumed directly by the setIlkAutoLineDebtCeiling core function.
changelog key parameter exists only to drive setChangelogAddress.
address value parameter exists only to drive setChangelogAddress.
base contract parameter is only used inside the authorize helper.
ward parameter is only used inside the authorize helper.
payment target parameter is only used inside sendPaymentFromSurplusBuffer.
payment amount parameter is only used inside sendPaymentFromSurplusBuffer.
CollateralOpts parameter is only consumed by addNewCollateral.
description parameter is stored by the DssExec constructor.
expiration parameter is stored by the DssExec constructor.
action address parameter is stored and hashed by the DssExec constructor.
cached vat local is only used to perform the increaseGlobalDebtCeiling file call.
local action copy exists solely for the assembly extcodehash computation.
local tag variable is written solely by the assembly extcodehash computation.
day local exists only for the block.timestamp office-hours branch of execute's limited modifier.
hour local exists only for the block.timestamp office-hours branch of execute's limited modifier.
cached flipperMom local is only used in the deauthorize calls.
UNIV2WBTCDAI-A struct literal is only passed into addNewCollateral.
UNIV2AAVEETH-A struct literal is only passed into addNewCollateral.
castTime local is computed and returned solely by nextCastTime.
